Dear Ritsu, Nice to meet you! My name is Hal Night Owl and I am a Vtuber on Twitch.
I was very attracted to Ritsu's illustration, and I would like to contact you to make a request.

[Character].

▷The hair is green in color at the part where the hair is cut off.
▷The zipper at the neck is marked NOWL
▷The character is described as a traveler

  Description of your request.
▷A full body illustration of Hal the Night Owl.
▷Please leave the outfit as is.
▷Other compositions and facial expressions are up to the artist.

Usage.
▷To be used as a thumbnail for a monetized Twitch streaming video, ending video, and OP video, and to be posted on the website and X.
(Images of only the characters with transparent backgrounds would also be appreciated.)

Reference materials
I would appreciate it if you could refer to ▷X and Google Drive.
This is my first request on skeb, so I may cause some inconvenience in terms of unfamiliarity, but I hope you will consider my request if you like...!

X https://twitter.com/yakyo_hal
Google Drive https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Xoaj6WUiIiy_ZrJgSHltzXcATewyBHxg
